name: 95252 · Valley Spgs, CA
findings: ZIP 95252 (Valley Spgs) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95252 (Valley Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95252 (Valley Spgs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
